description: This file contains automated internationalization (i18n) string definitions for the English locale, extracted from Vue views and related services. It defines a large nested object of translation entries under the 'translations' variable, covering various UI sections such as menu, header, dashboard, WAN, LAN, cellular, WLAN, statistics, mesh, system, wireless, diagnostics, firmware, reset, backup, XperienceControl, UPnP, Thread, Matter, login, wizard, and multiple settings pages. The file also exports the translation object for use in the application.
